A food item which restores energy and applies the Handyman mood buff when consumed. It must be made in the oven. For the main page on preparing food see cooking.

As of patch 1.405, the Handyman buff it applies does not actually impact any form of crafting([[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] broken). The buff from prayer of excellence still works though, as the game considers the two as different buffs (one can simultaneously have prayer of excellence and cheese pie buff active).
